title: Stop Calling Yourself Lazy. It's a Brain Glitch. #shorts

sentences.say: Neuroscience proved procrastination isn't a time problem.
Stare at a hard task, and your brain's alarm center treats it like a physical threat.
The exact same panic your ancestors felt facing a predator.
Since you can't punch a spreadsheet, your brain hits escape.
And hijacks your hand straight to your glowing phone.
Instant relief now. Massive guilt an hour later.
That's why pure willpower loses every single time.
Instead, shrink the task to five minutes so the alarm stays asleep.
I broke down all three science-backed tricks in the full video right below.
